title: First Year Korean I
description: This introductory course is designed to provide beginners with a solid foundation in modern Korean starting from the Korean alphabet. Throughout the course we will focus on the balanced development of the four basic language skills of speaking, listening comprehension, reading, and writing. At the end of semester students will be able to understand and articulate some basic idiomatic expressions and some basic grammatical patterns (e.g., sentence structure, speech levels, verb tenses) in conversation and writing and develop their understanding of aspects of Korean culture.
